children: Catalyst Acquisition announced separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares and rights commencing Sept. 17, 2026.
Holders of IPO units may elect to separate units into Class A ordinary shares and rights starting Sept. 17, 2026.
No fractional rights will be issued upon separation; only whole rights will trade.
Separated Class A shares expected to trade under symbol CATL and rights under CATLR on Nasdaq.
Units remaining intact will continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol CATLU.
Broker action required: holders must have brokers contact the transfer agent to effect separations.
